title: LOTUSim: Multi-Domain Simulator for Marine Robotics
venue: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
abstract: Simulation is essential for maritime robotics, supporting operator training, mission rehearsal, and human-vehicle interaction in environments where real-world testing is costly or hazardous. LOTUSim is an open-source, real-time maritime simulator supporting multi-user interaction across aerial, surface, and underwater robotic systems for coordinated naval-style operations, combining real-time interactive performance at scale with an Ekman-inspired underwater current model validated against ocean reanalysis data.

title: LOTUSim-Energy: A Maritime Simulator for Human-Drone Interaction in Autonomous Offshore Operation & Maintenance
venue: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) Workshop
abstract: LOTUSim-Energy is a real-time maritime simulator for multi-domain human-drone interaction in offshore wind operation and maintenance. It unifies heterogeneous unmanned vehicles (UAVs, USVs, AUVs, ROVs) within a distributed architecture coupling environmental forcing (wind, waves, currents), immersive desktop/VR supervision, energy-aware battery modeling, and fault-detection pipelines, demonstrated on a multi-domain inspection scenario for offshore wind turbine monopile and transition-piece structures.

title: RoboCup@Home SSPL Champion 2023: RoboBreizh, a Fully Embedded Approach
affiliations: College of Science and Engineering, Flinders University of South Australia, Adelaide, Australia
venue: RoboCup 2023: Robot World Cup XXVI (Lecture Notes in Computer Science)
abstract: This paper presents the approach employed by the team RoboBreizh to win the championship in the 2023 RoboCup@Home Social Standard Platform League (SSPL). RoboBreizh decided to limit itself to an entirely embedded system with no connection to the internet and external devices. This article describes the design of embedded solutions including the global architecture, perception, navigation, interaction, reasoning and digital twin.
